dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cén fáth nach féidir liom déileáil leis an dúshlán seo?
dialogue.translation: Why can't I deal with this challenge?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Is gá duit iarracht níos mó a dhéanamh, dar liom.
dialogue.translation: You need to make more effort, in my opinion.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tá mé ag iarraidh, ach is é an foghlaim atá an-deacair.
dialogue.translation: I'm trying, but the learning is very difficult.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ba chóir duit tacaíocht a lorg ó do mhúinteoir.
dialogue.translation: You should seek support from your teacher.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Chomh maith, b'fhéidir go sroichfinn mo spriocanna.
dialogue.translation: Also, maybe I would achieve my goals.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Is é sin an gné is tábhachtaí den fhadhb.
dialogue.translation: That's the most important aspect of the problem.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Go raibh maith agat, déanfaidh mé sin féin.
dialogue.translation: Thank you, I'll do that myself.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cad é an bealach is fearr chun an áit seo a thabhairt chuig? Tá dhá rogha againn.
dialogue.translation: What is the best way to get to this place? We have two options.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sea, tá sé dearfach níos fearr an chéad rogha ar an mbealach.
dialogue.translation: Yes, the first option is definitely better on the way.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cén nós atá ag an dara rogha? An bhfuil sé níos mó ná an chéad rogha?
dialogue.translation: What is the way of the second option? Is it more than the first option?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Is dóigh liom go bhfuil sé níos mó, ach is ba mhaith liom an chéad rogha.
dialogue.translation: I think it is more, but I would prefer the first option.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cén fáth? An bhfuil aon rud níos fearr ag an chéad rogha?
dialogue.translation: Why? Is there anything better about the first option?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sea, tá sé níos saoire agus níos dearfach ar an mbealach.
dialogue.translation: Yes, it is more relaxed and more positive on the way.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tá mé ag tabhairt léiriú ar an tionscadal nua atá againn. Ba mhaith liom an tús a chur ar an phríomhchúiseanna.
dialogue.translation: I am giving a presentation on the new project we have. I would like to start with the main principles.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Go maith. Tá sé thar a bheith tábhachtach go mbainfidh muid le chéile ar an obair seo.
dialogue.translation: Good. It is extremely important that we work together on this.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Chomh maith, tá sé soiléir go bhfuil an tionscadal seo chomh mór le háiríonna nua a fháil.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: An bhfuil aon phlean ar an mbord chun na hacmhainní a rialú?
dialogue.translation: Is there any plan on the table to manage the resources?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tá, táimid ag obair le comhlacht eile chun cabhrú linn.
dialogue.translation: Yes, we are working with another company to help us.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Gur mhaith an scéala sin. Cad faoi na tréithbheartais atá againn thart an tionscadal?
dialogue.translation: That’s good news. What about the milestones we have around the project?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Níl aon bhac againn fós. Táimid ar an mbealach ceart, de réir an chláir.
dialogue.translation: We have no delays yet. We are on the right track, according to the plan.

dialogue.translation: Do you follow any game in particular?

dialogue.text: Sea, tá mé ag leanúint rugbaí go minic. Is maith liom an baint atá agam leis.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I often follow rugby. I like the involvement I have with it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cén fáth a thóg tú suim sa rugbaí?
dialogue.translation: Why did you take an interest in rugby?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Is spórt é atá cois na farraige thart orm, seachas soccer.
dialogue.translation: It's a sport that is by the sea around me, except soccer.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: An bhfuil aon chluiche eile ar aon chor ort a leanúint?

dialogue.text: Nílim, ach má bhí cúrsa eile ann, d'fhéachfainn air.
dialogue.translation: I’m not, but if there was another course, I would look at it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Chomh maith, an bhfuil deireadh na cluiche go hálainn?
